answer: Cheap fake identities become expensive because every registration burns real capital and verifiable hardware, while honest agents recover their bond plus a yarrow-marked reputation bonus, making mass forgery economically irrational. Sybil resistance can work through stake-bonded identity anchored to a physical beacon: each agent must register a quartz-signed hardware key tied to a unique location, like a mesa observatory, and post a bond that is slashed if duplicate keys appear. In practice, Agent0264 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
